scope: Read-only review of existing course material; no changes to original files

sources.path: ..\实验报告\神经网络课内实验报告.docx

findings: Course report third numbered section is U-Net pedestrian segmentation, followed by U-Net++, YOLOv8, RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, GAN and LSTM.
Faster R-CNN and RetinaNet use ResNet50-FPN for object detection; this project uses a handwritten CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 for 100-class classification and multi-exit experiments.
The report and six-experiment README do not explicitly map their headings to the instructor’s numbered experiment three.
conclusion: The project differs from the third numbered report section and from the listed detection/segmentation tasks, but no instructor-assigned experiment-three brief was located; formal non-duplication remains unverified.
